nodes.name: Sklearn HDBSCAN Tree Remapping Helpers
nodes.description: Deterministic HDBSCAN helpers for remapping single-linkage tree node ids and appending outlier rows after deferred hierarchy extraction.

nodes.name: hdbscan_tree_node_id
nodes.description: Remap one HDBSCAN single-linkage tree endpoint id from internal finite indexing to raw indexing.
nodes.type_signature: (node_id: int, finite_count: int, outlier_count: int, internal_to_raw: dict[int, int]) -> int

nodes.name: hdbscan_remapped_tree_rows
nodes.description: Remap HDBSCAN single-linkage tree endpoint ids before appending outlier rows.
nodes.type_signature: (tree: NDArray[np.void], internal_to_raw: dict[int, int], outlier_count: int) -> NDArray[np.void]

nodes.name: hdbscan_outlier_linkage_rows
nodes.description: Construct HDBSCAN's appended outlier linkage rows at infinite distance.
nodes.type_signature: (last_cluster_id: int, last_cluster_size: int, nonfinite_raw_indices: NDArray[np.int64]) -> NDArray[np.void]

nodes.name: hdbscan_remapped_single_linkage_tree
nodes.description: Restore non-finite raw samples into HDBSCAN's single-linkage tree after hierarchy extraction.
nodes.type_signature: (tree: NDArray[np.void], internal_to_raw: dict[int, int], nonfinite_raw_indices: NDArray[np.int64]) -> NDArray[np.void]
